snippet.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - Exclusive Lore Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Expedition 33 is a turn-based RPG set in a stunning, painterly world where a mysterious curse dooms members of an ancient order to die at the age of 33. As the newest recruit, you must lead a diverse party of warriors, scholars, and survivors on a journey to break the cycle and rewrite fate. Explore beautifully crafted environments, battle deadly foes with tactical precision, and uncover the secrets behind a dying world.
